title: Synthetic Data Sub-Function Standup for Quality Engineering (Operating Model, Pods & KPIs)
author_notes: Effort tier: T5 (synthetic clinical data / AI test enablement; data-engineering/simulation/governance work, privacy care).

Synthetic-data & digital-twin tools (e.g. Synthea, commercial platforms) and AI/model frameworks integrated at the pattern level; vendor internals cited or deferred, never invented. Regulatory/legal interpretation (HIPAA/HITRUST de-identification, IRB/privacy sign-off, disclosure risk) deferred to privacy/compliance/legal. Never real PHI in a shared harness/twin/AI test env. Automation is Python.
hook: Stand up a synthetic-data capability inside quality engineering
problem: Building a synthetic data sub-function in a greenfield quality-engineering org is an operating-model problem, not just a tooling one. This solution stands up the capability end to end: the team structure (pods/squads), intake and prioritization, the reference architecture, the maturity model, and the KPIs that track engineering productivity and delivery quality — so synthetic data and simulation become a repeatable, measured service across programs and products.
whats_inside: Solution Overview — the synthetic-data sub-function: mission, scope, how it serves AI/QA teams, and the operating model.
Requirements Guide — each prerequisite with how to verify/implement (sponsorship, environment, governance stakeholders, target data model, pilot AI use cases).
Operating Model & Roadmap — team structure (pods/squads), intake/prioritization, reference architecture, a maturity model, and a delivery-quality + productivity KPI framework.

5 Python tools — assessment/profiling, generation or scenario execution, a fidelity/coverage report, a privacy/validation check, and a scope/config helper — authentic to synthetic-data engineering (safe by default; no real PHI written to shared locations).
Testing/validation gates + a Capability document template and Best Practices for scaling the sub-function across programs.
short: Stand up a synthetic data sub-function in quality engineering — pods/squads, intake, reference architecture, maturity model, and delivery-quality KPIs — so simulation becomes a repeatable, measured service. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
